title: 完整人工智能超级课程 2026
summary: 一个覆盖 AI 全栈学习路径的开源课程仓库，从 Python、数学基础到机器学习、深度学习、Transformer 与 LLM，再到 Prompt 工程、RAG、Agent、MCP、多模态、评估安全及 MLOps/LLMOps，最终以企业级 AI 项目收尾。
summary_en: An open-source curriculum repository covering a full AI learning path, from Python, math, and machine learning to deep learning, Transformers and LLMs, then Prompt Engineering, RAG, Agents, MCP, multimodal AI, evaluation and security, and MLOps/LLMOps, ending with an enterprise AI capstone.
